name: jungle_depths_mapstyle_b
prompt:
16-bit pixel art style-selection sheet for a top-down bomberman-style DEEP JUNGLE stage. Exactly 4 separate mini-map panels in a neat 2x2 grid on one flat plain cream background (#F7F1E3). Each panel is ONE complete 10x10 tile map seen from directly above like a board-game board, same scale and camera, each occupying one equal quarter with generous margin, nothing crossing between panels. No labels, no text, no numbers, no watermark, no UI, no frames, no characters. Every map is enclosed by dense vegetation on all four sides, with a readable network of open floor paths, 7-11 destructible blocks in small clusters, and exactly one multi-tile tree structure (3x2 tiles) per map. All tiles align to an invisible square grid.

OVERALL PALETTE (all four panels): light, airy PALE GREEN theme, not dark and not swampy. Pale mint green, soft sage green, yellow-green, young leaf green, cream-white highlights, mid-green accents, thin dark green outline (#2F4A28), a little warm brown only for tree bark and soil. Bright daylight, top-left light, flat cel shading with 2-3 tones, crisp hand-placed pixels, 1px selective outline, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no drop shadows.

TREES EVERYWHERE (main feature): the majority of wall props are TREES - slim tree trunks with round leaf canopies, young trees, leafy bushes, giant roots; stone is only a secondary accent. Many destructible blocks are TREE-TYPE blocks: a small leafy sapling on a block, a bush block, a cut log / stump block, a palm-shoot block. Each map has MANY trees, clearly more trees than stone. One small snake-themed accent per map only: a tiny snake-scale carving on one brick or one tree trunk.

TOP-LEFT - PALE MOSSY GROVE: floor of pale sage stone slabs with soft mint moss and grass tufts; walls are slim young trees, leafy bushes, two mossy stone blocks; destructible blocks are small leafy saplings, mossy stumps, one pale green snake-scale carved block; the 3x2 structure is a giant banyan root arch covered in leaves.

TOP-RIGHT - SUNLIT MEADOW: floor of light yellow-green grass with pale dirt paths, fallen leaves and tiny white flowers; walls are tree trunks with bright green canopies, ferns, one fallen log; destructible blocks are bush blocks, sapling blocks, log stumps, one with a carved serpent coil; the 3x2 structure is a fallen hollow log arch with mushrooms and ferns.

BOTTOM-LEFT - PALE BAMBOO: floor of pale mint earth with bamboo leaf litter; walls are bamboo clusters and young bamboo shoots, a few pale stone blocks; destructible blocks are bamboo-shoot blocks, pale green bamboo crates, one snake-scale bamboo block; the 3x2 structure is a bamboo gate with a small carved serpent on the top beam.

BOTTOM-RIGHT - ANCIENT TREE COURT: floor of pale jade-green stone pavers overgrown with light grass and roots; walls are massive ancient tree roots, young trees, fern clumps; destructible blocks are cut-log blocks, leafy sapling blocks, one jade snake-relief block; the 3x2 structure is a huge hollow ancient tree trunk gate with a carved snake coiled around its root.

RULES: bright pale-green daylight jungle, heavy tree cover, tree-type bricks abundant; snake motifs are tiny accents only; all four maps share identical tile scale, outline weight, light direction and detail level; every walkable cell must read clearly differently from every blocking cell.
